messages/messages.yml.rawContents:
imports:
  messagesRoot: __package__.yml
service:
  auth: false
  base-path: ''
  endpoints:
    listMessages:
      path: /messages
      method: GET
      source:
        openapi: messages.yml
      response:
        docs: OK
        type: list<messagesRoot.Message>
        status-code: 200
      errors:
        - messagesRoot.UnauthorizedError
        - messagesRoot.TooManyRequestsError
      examples:
        - response:
            body:
              - sid: sid
                body: body
    createMessage:
      path: /messages
      method: POST
      source:
        openapi: messages.yml
      request: messagesRoot.Message
      response:
        docs: Created
        type: messagesRoot.Message
        status-code: 201
      errors:
        - messagesRoot.BadRequestError
        - messagesRoot.UnprocessableEntityError
        - messagesRoot.TooManyRequestsError
      examples:
        - request:
            sid: sid
            body: body
          response:
            body:
              sid: sid
              body: body
    deleteMessage:
      path: /messages/{sid}
      method: DELETE
      source:
        openapi: messages.yml
      request:
        name: DeleteMessageRequest
        path-parameters:
          sid: string
      errors:
        - messagesRoot.NotFoundError
      examples:
        - path-parameters:
            sid: sid
  source:
    openapi: messages.yml
